articles.source: Dynasty-2025-Spring.pdf｜雜誌第 02 頁｜Winter Fades, Spring Awakens
sentences: As winter fades and spring arrives, people celebrate the season’s change and the start of a new year after enduring the long, cold months.
In Austria, they turn to mythical creatures to banish the final winter night, while in Japan, the blooming flowers signal the arrival of early spring.
The Lantern Festival marks the end of the lunar New Year, and then the celebrations begin—just before Lent arrives.

articles.title: 奧地利 Glöckler Runs 冬夜慶典｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
sentences: Austria’s Salzkammergut, a UNESCO World Heritage Site known for its stunning scenery, celebrates the Glöckler Runs winter night festival on the eve of Epiphany.
Participants portray Glöcklers, symbolic spirits of light, wear glowing, bell-shaped hats and use bells to chase away evil, symbolizing the awakening of nature beneath the snow.
There are direct flights from Taipei to Europe, with six major destinations including Amsterdam, Prague, Vienna, Rome, Frankfurt, and London.

articles.title: 日本初春花季｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
articles.source: Dynasty-2025-Spring.pdf｜雜誌第 03 頁｜Japanese Flower Seasons
sentences: Tokyo’s Shinjuku Gyoen is known for its Somei Yoshino cherry blossoms, which bloom from late March to April.

Japan’s early-blooming cherry varieties, such as February’s Kanhi-zakura, early March’s Kawazu-zakura, and April’s Kasumi-zakura and Yaezakura, highlight 65 unique types of cherry blossoms, each celebrating spring in its own way.
There are daily flights from Taipei and Kaohsiung to Narita, and daily flights from Songshan to Haneda.

articles.title: 韓國元宵節習俗｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
sentences: In the Chinese cultural sphere, the first full moon after Lunar New Year is marked by the Lantern Festival, where lanterns are lit for good fortune.
In Korea, the day is celebrated by eating Patjuk, or red bean porridge, nuts, and drinking Eominju liquor to wish for health and sharp senses in the new year.
Koreans also burn straw piles to pray for a bountiful harvest and make wishes to the full moon as it rises.
There are daily flights from Taipei and Kaohsiung to Incheon individually, and five weekly flights from Songshan and Kaohsiung to Gimpo individually.

articles.title: 美國紐奧良狂歡節｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
articles.source: Dynasty-2025-Spring.pdf｜雜誌第 03 頁｜Mardi Gras Season
sentences: Mardi Gras, meaning Fat Tuesday in French, marks the final day of indulgence before the 40-day Christian Lent.
New Orleans celebrates with masquerade parade.
The festival’s signature colors—purple, green, and gold—symbolize justice, faith, and power, with homes and streets adorned in these hues for the ultimate day of revelry.
There are 10 weekly flights on the Taipei-Los Angeles route.

articles.title: 活力風情賀慶典｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
articles.source: Dynasty-2025-Summer.pdf｜雜誌第 02 頁｜A Lively Celebration of Global Festivities
sentences: As the Northern Hemisphere awakens from spring’s revival and quietly greets summer, the grand Expo 2025 Osaka stands poised to dazzle visitors with imaginative wonders.
Meanwhile, Europe’s Easter bunny hops in with joyful surprises, and Canada’s Victoria Day sparks a wave of enthusiasm.
Down in the Southern Hemisphere, autumn descends on Sydney in a blaze of brilliant light installations—outshining even the stars.

articles.title: 日本大阪世界博覽會｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
sentences: Since 1851, the World Expo has showcased global achievements in culture, technology, and industry.
In 2025, Osaka will host its second Expo with the theme “Society 5.0.”
The event, taking place on Yumeshima Island, will showcase a stunning wooden circular pavilion spanning 60,000 square meters, designed by architect Sou Fujimoto.
With 159 participating countries, it is expected to attract 28 million visitors.
There are 21 weekly flights on Taipei-Osaka route, and 10 weekly flights on Kaohsiung-Osaka route.

articles.title: 捷克布拉格復活節｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
articles.source: Dynasty-2025-Summer.pdf｜雜誌第 03 頁｜Easter in Czech
sentences: In the Czech Republic, Easter combines artistry and tradition, with wax-dyed eggs exchanged as gifts and lively markets offering traditional foods and crafts.
The unique Pomlázka custom sees men tapping women with willow twigs, symbolizing wishes for health and vitality.
There are direct flights from Taipei to Europe, with six major destinations including Amsterdam, Prague, Vienna, Rome, Frankfurt, and London.

articles.title: 加拿大維多利亞日｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
sentences: Canada celebrates Victoria Day on the last Monday before May 25, honoring Queen Victoria’s birthday and marking summer’s arrival.

Festivities include a 21-gun salute in Ottawa and provincial capitals, with Victoria city hosting the grandest celebrations, featuring parades and fireworks that stretch from daytime revelry into the night.
There are seven weekly flights on the Taipei-Vancouver route.

articles.title: 繽紛雪梨燈光音樂節｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
sentences: The dazzling Vivid Sydney marks its 15th year with the theme “Dream,” attracting half a million attendees annually to this outdoor light art spectacle.
Iconic landmarks like the Sydney Opera House and Harbour Bridge will be illuminated with dazzling projections, lighting up the night sky.
The festival also features live music, gourmet food, and creative exchange forums, making it an unmissable event.
There are five weekly flights on the Taipei-Sydney route.

articles.title: 秋天藝文盛事｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
articles.source: Dynasty-2025-Autumn.pdf｜雜誌第 02 頁｜Autumn Spotlight on Global Stages
sentences: As leaves turn in the Northern Hemisphere, creativity bursts into full color.
From Belgium’s headbanging music fest echoing summer’s energy, to Korea’s contemporary art fairs drawing thousands of trendsetters, the season brims with inspiration.
In the U.S., Fashion Week looks ahead to Spring and Summer 2026, while Down Under, Australia lights up with the glamor of international film festival.

articles.title: 比利時 Tomorrowland 電子音樂節｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
sentences: Since its 2005 debut in Belgium with just 9,000 fans, Tomorrowland has become a global icon of electronic dance music, now drawing 400,000 attendees and expanding to the U.S., Brazil, and France.
This year, under the frosty-fantasy theme Orbyz, the festival unleashes two weekends of nonstop energy, featuring hundreds of artists across 16 spectacular stages.
There are direct flights from Taipei to Europe, with six major destinations including Amsterdam, Prague, Vienna, Rome, Frankfurt, and London.

articles.title: 墨爾本國際電影節｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
articles.source: Dynasty-2025-Autumn.pdf｜雜誌第 03 頁｜Melbourne International Film Festival
sentences: Founded in 1952, the Melbourne International Film Festival is the world’s fourth-longest-running, following Venice, Cannes, and Berlin.
Held every August, the three-week celebration screens over 200 feature and short films.
Since 2022, it has awarded the Bright Horizons Award for Best Film, drawing around 150,000 cinema lovers each year.
There are four weekly flights on Taipei-Melbourne route.

articles.title: 首爾 Frieze 藝術博覽會｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
sentences: Launched in 1991, Frieze spans global art cities like Chicago, London, New York, and Los Angeles.
Now in its fourth edition, Frieze Seoul has quickly become Asia’s rising art hub, showcasing over 100 leading galleries.
The fair features Frieze Masters for pre-20th century works and Focus Asia—a spotlight on emerging talents from Asian countries.
There are daily flights on Taipei-Incheon and Kaohsiung-Incheon routes, and three weekly flights on Songshan-Gimpo routes.

articles.title: 紐約時裝週｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
articles.source: Dynasty-2025-Autumn.pdf｜雜誌第 03 頁｜New York Fashion Week
sentences: As one of the “Big Four” alongside Paris, London, and Milan, New York Fashion Week takes place each February and September.
Born in 1943 during World War II, it offered a stateside alternative when travel to Paris was impossible.
Today, it remains a trendsetting stage, spotlighting top designers and debuting next season’s Spring and Summer styles.
There are four weekly flights on Taipei-New York route.

articles.title: 七彩繽紛，歡度冬日｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
articles.source: Dynasty-2025-Winter.pdf｜雜誌第 02 頁｜A Winter of Color and Celebration
sentences: While winter often conjures images of cold nights and snowy silence, it’s also the season when festivals burst to life in vibrant color.

Picture rainbow-colored hot air balloons rising into a clear sky, dazzling light installations along city canals, literary gatherings that spark thoughtful reflection, and Christmas stockings hung with anticipation for Santa’s warm-hearted arrival.

articles.title: 美國阿布奎基國際熱氣球嘉年華｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
articles.source: Dynasty-2025-Winter.pdf｜雜誌第 02 頁｜The Albuquerque International Balloon Fiesta
sentences: Held annually in New Mexico since 1972, the Albuquerque International Balloon Fiesta is the world’s largest hot air balloon festival.
Each year, it draws over 100,000 visitors and features more than 500 balloons, from hand-painted designs and whimsical shapes to illuminated night flights.
The main event—Mass Ascension—sees all balloons lift off in two grand waves, creating a breathtaking spectacle against the desert sky.
There are 10 weekly flights on Taipei-Los Angeles route, and seven weekly flights on Taipei-Ontario route.

articles.title: 荷蘭阿姆斯特丹燈光節｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
articles.source: Dynasty-2025-Winter.pdf｜雜誌第 03 頁｜Amsterdam Light Festival
sentences: Light art has illuminated Europe’s public spaces since the 1920s, and Amsterdam carries on that tradition with its Light Festival, launched in 2012.
For seven weeks, visitors can enjoy canal cruises that pass by striking installations from international artists.
The event has expanded to include live music and talks, drawing as many as 900,000 attendees each year.
There are direct flights from Taipei to Europe, with six major destinations including Amsterdam, Prague, Vienna, Rome, Frankfurt, and London.

articles.title: 印尼烏布文學節｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
articles.source: Dynasty-2025-Winter.pdf｜雜誌第 03 頁｜Ubud Writers & Readers Festival
sentences: The Ubud Writers & Readers Festival gathers authors, poets, and thinkers for five days of literary events, including talks, readings, music, workshops, and themed luncheons.
This year’s theme, Aham Brahmasmi—an ancient Sanskrit phrase meaning “I am the universe”—invites reflection on the deep ties between humanity and the cosmos.
There are seven weekly flights on Taipei-Denpasar Bali route.

articles.title: 香港繽紛冬日巡禮｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
articles.source: Dynasty-2025-Winter.pdf｜雜誌第 03 頁｜Hong Kong WinterFest
sentences: Hong Kong’s WinterFest brings a joyful close to the year with a series of festive events.
A romantic Christmas village lights up the West Kowloon Cultural District.
On New Year’s Eve, fireworks burst over Victoria Harbour, transforming the night sky into a brilliant canvas.
There are 49 weekly flights on Taipei-Hong Kong route, and 14 weekly flights on Kaohsiung-Hong Kong route.

articles.title: 2025 華航月曆 Take It Easy, Take It Slow
sentences: China Airlines’ 2025 calendar themed “Take It Easy, Take It Slow,” transforms travel moments into catchy captions, styled like popular social media posts to inspire the urge to fly and “create more beautiful moments through flight.”
The calendar features uniformed staff set against the stunning backdrops of the airline’s key destinations.
The cover and January feature Taiwan’s Bitou Cape and Alishan’s Eryanping Trail at sunrise, symbolizing new beginnings and hope as travelers depart from Taiwan.

March brings viewers to Vietnam’s Golden Bridge in Da Nang, May extends to Banff National Park in Canada, July evokes Seattle’s cinematic charm, and September transports viewers to Karlovy Vary in the Czech Republic for a rejuvenating mineral spring.

articles.title: 首屆華航馬拉松星光夜跑
sentences: Held at Taipei’s Dajia Riverside Park, the first China Airlines’ Marathon Starlight Night Run featured a half marathon, a 10K fun run, and a 5K family run, setting a record for the largest night-run participation in Taiwan.
China Airlines’ Marathon blends a music party and lifestyle market, creating a fresh sports carnival and promoting a healthy lifestyle.
China Airlines has long supported local teams and athletes, nurturing new sports talent and regularly hosting charity sports camps to promote children’s fitness.

The marathon also collaborates with Taiwan Vision Defective Road Run Association, offering charity race entries, and partners with Jen Ji Shiang Social Service Association of Taipei City to promote food-sharing initiatives.

articles.title: A350 客艙升級預計 2027 上線
sentences: China Airlines has commissioned Airbus to retrofit 15 A350 aircraft with new cabin designs, expected to debut in 2027.
The upgrade will blend Eastern aesthetics with innovative cabin features, enhancing the airline’s brand and delivering an unparalleled flying experience.
Since 2016, China Airlines has led the industry with its A350 fleet, featuring 32 Premium Business Class, 31 Premium Economy, and 243 Economy seats, totaling 306.
Known for being eco-friendly, the aircraft incorporates 70% advanced composite materials, reducing weight and boosting safety.
Airbus will assist with the retrofit, and the entire project involving 15 aircraft is set to be completed by 2028.

articles.title: APEX 五星航空與餐飲、Wi-Fi 三項大獎
sentences: China Airlines has earned three prestigious honors from the Airline Passenger Experience Association, including the “Five Star Global Airline” title, “Best in Food and Beverage,” and “Best in Wi-Fi.”
These accolades highlight the airline’s exceptional service quality on the global stage.
The Five Star Global Airline title is determined through passenger votes based on criteria such as seat comfort, in-flight service, dining, entertainment, and Wi-Fi.
China Airlines stood out from over 600 airlines worldwide, securing the honor for the ninth consecutive year, along with dual awards for its in-flight dining and Wi-Fi services.

articles.title: 首屆公益羽球營與新林洋配
sentences: China Airlines hosted its first charity badminton camp, featuring Olympic gold medalist Lee Yang and rising star Lin Jun-Yi as the new “Lin-Yang Duo,” inspiring young players with a one-day-only partnership.
Gold medalist coach Lee Yang shared his motivational mantra: “It’s not because we see hope that we persist, but because we persist, we find hope.”
Lin Jun-Yi encouraged participants to stay true to their passion and prioritize learning with happiness.
The camp featured comprehensive training sessions, including warm-ups, grip techniques, racket swings, power shots, and mastering angles.

articles.title: 華航董事長與總經理新任命
sentences: China Airlines appointed the current President of CAL, Mr.
Kao Shing-Hwang, as the new Chairman, and Tigerair Taiwan Chairman, Mr.
Chen Han-Ming, as the new President.
Chairman Kao has served with CAL since 1986.
After completing his pilot training, he progressed through the positions of First Officer, Captain, Check Pilot, and Instructor Pilot.
He joined the management team in 2003, and under his leadership CAL delivered the best-ever performance in its 65-year history.
President Chen joined the CAL Board as a director in 2016 and became Chairman of Tigerair Taiwan in 2020.
CAL’s latest management team devotes to usher in a new era and realizes the goal of “Leading Asia-Pacific, Flying Worldwide.”

articles.title: 華航歡送旅外投手陳偉殷退休
sentences: Taiwan’s celebrated baseball star Wei-Yin Chen officially retired at Nagoya Dome.
Returning home in honor, he was welcomed by China Airlines Chairman Kao Shing-Hwang, who expressed gratitude for Chen’s dedication to Taiwanese baseball.
Since 2013, China Airlines has proudly supported Chen’s global career, providing travel that felt like a touch of home.
Off the field, he has also devoted himself to grassroots baseball education, hosting charity camps across Taitung, Taoyuan, Taichung, and Hualien.
Chairman Kao presented Chen with a commemorative 777 aircraft model, celebrating a brilliant 20-year career.

articles.title: 台北直飛鳳凰城於 12 月 3 日開航
sentences: Starting December 3, China Airlines will begin nonstop service between Taipei and Phoenix with three weekly flights operated by the Airbus A350-900.
This milestone makes China Airlines the first Asian carrier to serve Arizona’s capital, enhancing its global network while leveraging Phoenix’s emergence as a key tech hub in the American Southwest.
The service will operate every Wednesday, Friday, and Sunday.
With over 50 years of service in North America, China Airlines now flies to seven destinations across the region, offering 40 weekly flights and seamless connections across the United States.

articles.title: 華航進駐紐約新第一航廈
sentences: China Airlines will begin operations at the New Terminal One at New York’s John F.
Kennedy International Airport starting in 2026.
The New Terminal One is a high-tech facility currently under construction, featuring modern design and a wide array of dining and retail options.

Sustainability is a key focus of the terminal, which will feature the largest solar panel installation among U.S. airport terminals, 100% electric ground service equipment, and rainwater reuse systems.
China Airlines now operates over 40 weekly round-trip flights to six major North American cities, with nearly 500 connections via Taiwan to and from Southeast Asia and Northeast Asia.

articles.title: EVA_FINAL_QUESTIONS 1
sentences: Good morning.
I'm Shelly Chang.
I've worked at the front desk of Hyatt Place for one year, serving international guests in a fast-paced environment.
I speak Mandarin, English and Korean, and my coworkers see me as someone they can rely on.
I hope to bring that calm and reliability into the cabin.

articles.title: EVA_FINAL_QUESTIONS 2
sentences: At the hotel, I once helped a Colombian guest through an online process that was only available in Chinese.
He came back the next day to thank me.
That showed me how much I value helping people when travel feels unfamiliar.
Cabin crew also carry responsibility for safety, and that is the next level I want to take on.

articles.title: EVA_FINAL_QUESTIONS 3
sentences: I want to join EVA Air because I work best in a clear, disciplined system.
At the hotel, I check the facts and my authority before offering a solution, and after a mistake I created a checklist to prevent it from happening again.
I want to bring that same process-minded and caring approach into the cabin.

articles.title: EVA_FINAL_QUESTIONS 8
sentences: At Hyatt Place, I have already tested three things: staying calm under pressure, finding ways through language barriers, and turning mistakes into better processes.
I know hotel experience cannot replace airline training, so I would learn safety and SOP with a beginner's attitude.
But I can bring steadiness and reliability to the team from day one.

articles.title: EVA_FINAL_QUESTIONS 9
sentences: My coworkers would say I am the person they do not need to check on.
During a holiday rush, they trusted me to keep waiting guests informed while they followed up with housekeeping.
That trust taught me that reliability is not a label; it is built by following through every time.

articles.title: EVA_FINAL_QUESTIONS 11
sentences: I used to rely too much on memory when I was busy.
Early in my job, I missed a room-type confirmation and the guest was checked into the wrong room.
I owned the mistake, fixed it, and created a checklist.
Now I remind myself that working quickly must never mean skipping a verification step.

articles.title: EVA_FINAL_QUESTIONS 12
sentences: Early in my job, I missed confirming a member's room upgrade and the guest entered the wrong room.
I apologised, corrected it immediately, and checked with my manager on a suitable recovery.
Then I built a checklist and started reading key details back.
I learned that accountability means making the same mistake harder to repeat.

articles.title: EVA_FINAL_QUESTIONS 13
sentences: A guest once broke down at the front desk.
The room issue was only the surface problem; she had missed a flight that morning and was exhausted.
I let her explain, understood that she needed rest and a workable arrangement for her group, and offered a sofa-bed solution.
I learned to understand the emotion before fixing the visible problem.

articles.title: EVA_FINAL_QUESTIONS 14
sentences: Good service means noticing first, then checking rather than assuming.
When I noticed a pregnant guest looked uncomfortable, I quietly asked before moving her to a room closer to the lift.
She still had a choice.
Good service is not doing the most; it is offering the right help at the right time.

articles.title: EVA_FINAL_QUESTIONS 15
sentences: What would you do if you disagreed with a senior crew member?

articles.title: EVA_FINAL_QUESTIONS 15
sentences: If safety is not affected, I would follow the team's direction first and discuss my concern privately at the right time.
If it involves safety or a clear procedure, I would state the facts and the SOP, and escalate through the proper channel if needed.
The goal is complete information and uninterrupted teamwork, not proving who is right.

articles.title: EVA_FINAL_QUESTIONS 32
sentences: How would you help a passenger who cannot communicate well in English?

articles.title: EVA_FINAL_QUESTIONS 32
sentences: I would use short sentences, gestures and visual information to identify the basic need, then use an approved translation tool or ask a crew member who speaks the language.
For safety information, I would use standard demonstrations and confirm understanding rather than guess.
Good communication means both sides understand the same thing.

articles.title: EVA_FINAL_QUESTIONS 33
sentences: What would you do if China Airlines also offered you a position?

articles.title: EVA_FINAL_QUESTIONS 33
sentences: I would make a responsible decision based on the commitment I have made, not use two airlines to negotiate against each other.
While applying to EVA Air, I am focused on its process and role requirements.
If I accept an offer, I would respect that commitment and communicate any decision early.

articles.title: 航空／旅遊
sentences: A delayed flight can be stressful, especially when passengers do not know what will happen next.
Clear updates help people make decisions and reduce confusion.
Even when there is no new information, telling passengers when the next update will come can make the wait feel more manageable.

articles.title: 城市
sentences: Lisbon is known for its steep streets, yellow trams and views across the river.
Many visitors explore the city on foot, but comfortable shoes are important.
Small neighbourhood cafes are often busiest in the late afternoon, when local residents stop for coffee and conversation.

articles.title: 飲食
sentences: Fermented food is part of many cultures.
Yogurt, kimchi and sourdough are made with microorganisms that change flavour and texture over time.
Although these foods share a similar process, their taste and role at the table can be very different.

articles.title: 文化
sentences: In some cultures, direct eye contact shows confidence.
In others, long eye contact may feel uncomfortable or disrespectful.
Good communication therefore requires more than correct words.
It also requires attention to how the other person responds.

articles.title: 健康
sentences: Short periods of movement can be useful during a long day.
A brief walk, gentle stretching or standing for a few minutes may help people feel more alert.
The goal is not intense exercise, but a regular change of position.

articles.title: 環境
sentences: Many cities are planting more trees to reduce heat in crowded neighbourhoods.
Trees provide shade and may improve air quality, but they also need water and long-term care.
Choosing the right species is important when space is limited.

articles.title: 科技
sentences: Digital translation tools are improving quickly, but they still make mistakes with context and tone.
They can support simple communication, yet important medical or safety information should be confirmed carefully rather than trusted without checking.

articles.title: 日常生活
sentences: A small library started lending tools as well as books.
Residents can borrow drills, sewing machines and gardening equipment for a few days.
The programme saves money and storage space, while also helping neighbours share practical skills.

articles.title: 一般新聞型短文
sentences: A regional railway introduced quieter carriages after a three-month trial.
Passengers in these areas are asked to keep phone calls short and use headphones.
The rule is voluntary, but early feedback suggests that clear signs make cooperation easier.

articles.title: FRAMES 1
sentences: Good morning, my name is Shelly Chang.
I currently work at the front desk of the Hyatt Place, serving international guests every day.
I speak Mandarin, English and Korean — TOEIC 795 and TOPIK Level 4 — and I've studied in Canada and spent an exchange semester in Korea.
My colleagues call me their go-to person, not because of seniority, but because anything handed to me never needs checking twice.
I'd like to bring that care and steadiness into the 〇〇 cabin.

articles.title: FRAMES 2
sentences: I decided on this path during my first year at the hotel.
I once helped a foreign guest through a car rental process that wasn't part of my job, and the next day he came back to thank me.
That's when I realised my greatest fulfilment comes from being part of someone else's journey.
That year at the front desk was my pre-employment training: pressure, cross-cultural service, complaints — I've done all of it.
I chose 〇〇 because 〔specific company fact〕, which matches 〔my own strength〕.

articles.title: FRAMES 3
sentences: I'd apologise first and settle the passenger's emotions so they know I'm listening.
Then I'd confirm what they actually need, to avoid any misunderstanding.
Next I'd offer a workable alternative within my authority; if it exceeds my authority, I'd report to the purser immediately rather than leaving them waiting.
Finally I'd check back on them later in the service to make sure they're alright.

articles.title: FRAMES 4
sentences: I'd let them finish first without rushing to defend myself — being heard already takes half the heat out of it.
I wouldn't match their energy; I'd keep my tone steady and focus on what they're actually upset about rather than how they're saying it.
Then I'd offer a solution within the rules; if the request goes beyond regulations or would be unfair to other passengers, I'd explain clearly and politely what is possible.
If it keeps escalating or involves safety, I'd notify the purser immediately rather than handling it alone.

articles.title: FRAMES 5
sentences: My first principle here is that safety comes before service.
I'd assess the situation and notify the purser immediately, with the captain deciding on further action if required.
Then I'd work through the SOP with the other crew — 〔retrieving equipment / making a medical announcement / directing passengers〕.
I wouldn't handle anything beyond my authority or training alone, and I'd keep monitoring until we hand over to the ground team after landing.

articles.title: FRAMES 6
sentences: 【Situation】On a holiday weekend at the hotel, housekeeping fell behind and guests began queuing for rooms.
【Task】I had to clear the backlog while making sure guests never felt our panic.
【Action】I steadied the queue with clear updates, checked live room status with housekeeping, proposed flexible room reassignments to my manager, and offered late checkout as compensation.
【Result】Every guest was roomed and the mood turned around.
It taught me that under pressure, communication, coordination and decision-making have to happen at the same time.

articles.title: FRAMES 7
sentences: 〔Airline〕 was founded in 〔year〕, is hubbed at 〔city〕 and belongs to 〔alliance〕.
What stays with me most is 〔brand detail〕.
Most recently, 〔new route / new fleet〕.
That matches 〔my own experience〕, which is why I want to work here.

articles.title: FRAMES 8
sentences: I'd like to ask two things.
First, what core capability does the company most want new cabin crew to build during training?
I'd like to prepare in that direction before I report for duty.
Second, how does 〔recent company initiative〕 actually translate to the cabin?
As crew I'd be the one carrying it out and explaining it to passengers.

articles.title: STORY_BILINGUAL 1
sentences: A Colombian guest was stuck because the car-rental and online check-in information was only in Chinese.
I noticed his difficulty, translated the key steps, and helped him complete the process.
He came back the next day to thank me, which showed me that good service means taking an extra step when someone needs help.

articles.title: STORY_BILINGUAL 2
sentences: I noticed that a pregnant guest was standing uncomfortably.
She did not ask for help, but I prepared a cushion and helped arrange a room near the elevator.
She later mentioned it in her review.
It taught me that excellent service often begins before a guest has to ask.

articles.title: STORY_BILINGUAL 3
sentences: After housekeeping had finished for the day, a guest reported crumbs in the room.
I had never used the vacuum before, but I went upstairs, worked it out, cleaned the room, and left a handover note.
I learned that when a problem appears, finding a way forward matters more than making excuses.

articles.title: STORY_BILINGUAL 4
sentences: A guest had missed her flight that morning, and a problem with the room became the last straw.
I let her finish speaking instead of rushing to explain.
After understanding that she mainly needed rest, I converted the sofa into a bed.
I learned to calm the emotion first, then solve the practical problem.

articles.title: STORY_BILINGUAL 5
sentences: A Korean guest who had been drinking asked for my personal phone number.
I stayed polite but set a clear boundary, offered the hotel's service line instead, and alerted the tour guide to keep an eye on him.
This allowed me to remain professional without escalating the situation.

articles.title: STORY_BILINGUAL 6
sentences: During a holiday peak, housekeeping fell behind and many guests were waiting to check in.
I first kept the waiting guests calm, checked room status with housekeeping, and proposed flexible room changes and late check-out options.
It taught me how to prioritise under pressure while keeping guests informed.

articles.title: STORY_BILINGUAL 7
sentences: I once entered the wrong room type and failed to confirm a member's upgrade benefit.
I apologised, corrected the mistake, and offered appropriate compensation.
Afterwards, I created a checklist for the items most likely to be missed.
I learned that after admitting a mistake, the next step is to build a system that prevents it from happening again.

articles.title: STORY_BILINGUAL 8
sentences: A high-tier member was in a hurry, so I did not fully explain his benefits, and I later gave an amenity to the wrong guest.
I did not make excuses.
I sat down with him, explained each benefit, and confirmed what he needed.
It reminded me that service is not only about completing a task; it is also about making sure the guest feels informed and valued.

articles.title: STORY_BILINGUAL 9
sentences: I spent a semester on exchange in Korea and had to build a new daily life and social circle from scratch.
I learned to read context, facial expressions, and non-verbal signals, and I also passed TOPIK Level 4.
The experience made me more adaptable and taught me to communicate in a way that feels comfortable for the other person.

articles.title: STORY_BILINGUAL 10
sentences: During my study program at Selkirk in Canada, I learned that people often communicate more directly, but directness does not mean rudeness.
I began to understand the cultural context before judging the tone.
That experience made me more flexible in international service situations.

articles.title: STORY_BILINGUAL 11
sentences: During my internship at the Xinzhuang Culture and Arts Center, I helped coordinate the venue setup and staff for an exhibition opening.
I had to confirm details with different departments and adjust the plan in real time.
It strengthened my coordination skills and taught me that teamwork works best when everyone knows the next step.

articles.title: STORY_BILINGUAL 12
sentences: My colleagues call me Senior Sister, not because I have the most seniority, but because tasks given to me usually do not need to be checked twice.
I remember the standards, confirm details proactively, and report back when the work is done.
To me, reliability is not just an adjective; it is what makes people comfortable trusting you with responsibility.

articles.title: 韻律教室裡跳舞的女生（星宇實際考題）
sentences: I see a young woman practising alone in a dance studio, surrounded by mirrors.
She looks focused rather than performing for anyone.
What strikes me is that nobody is watching — she's repeating the same movement because she wants it to be right.
It reminds me of how I prepared for service work: the quality people see comes from the practice they don't.
To me, that's what professionalism looks like.

articles.title: 機場大廳裡看著航班資訊板的旅客
sentences: A traveller is standing in the terminal looking up at the departure board, luggage at his feet and some worry on his face.
He may have just learned his flight is delayed, or he's unsure where to go.
If I were crew, I'd approach and ask whether he needs help finding his gate — often people don't ask because they don't want to trouble anyone.
To me, noticing that hesitation is where service begins.

articles.title: 祖孫兩人在公園長椅上分享食物
sentences: An elderly person and a child are sharing a snack on a park bench.
The older one is handing over the bigger half without hesitation.
It's a small moment, but it says a lot about care — giving the better part without making it a gesture.
It reminds me of my grandmother, who taught me Taiwanese and always did things like that.
To me, that quiet kind of care is exactly what good service feels like.

articles.title: 雨天騎樓下陌生人共撐一把傘
sentences: Two strangers are sheltering under one umbrella during a downpour.
Neither seems to know the other, but one has clearly tilted the umbrella toward the other person.
What I find moving is that helping didn't require a relationship — just noticing someone was getting wet.
In the cabin we serve people we've never met before and will likely never meet again.
To me, this picture is what that kind of service should feel like.

articles.title: 深夜便利商店的店員與唯一的客人
sentences: It's late at night in a convenience store, and the clerk is serving the only customer there.
Even with nobody else watching, the clerk is still handing over the bag with both hands.
That's what stays with me — service quality that doesn't depend on being observed.
I worked night shifts at a hotel front desk and learned exactly that.
To me, professionalism is what you do when it would be easy not to.

articles.title: 機艙內組員蹲下與孩童說話
sentences: A crew member has crouched down in the aisle to speak to a child at eye level.
She didn't have to — she could have leaned over from standing.
But by lowering herself she removed the height difference, which makes a child feel spoken to rather than instructed.
To me, that small adjustment is the difference between delivering service and actually connecting with someone.

articles.title: Welcome announcement (English)
sentences: Ladies and gentlemen, good morning and welcome aboard.
Our flying time to Tokyo today will be approximately three hours and twenty minutes.
We will be departing shortly, so please return to your seat, fasten your seatbelt, and ensure your seat back and tray table are upright and stowed.
If there is anything you need, please let our cabin crew know.
We wish you a pleasant flight.
Thank you.

articles.title: Captain's announcement 英翻中
sentences: Ladies and gentlemen, this is your captain speaking.
Due to weather conditions at our destination, air traffic control has asked us to hold for approximately fifteen minutes.
Please remain seated with your seatbelt fastened.
We will keep you updated.
Thank you for your patience.

articles.title: Seattle 與咖啡香｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
sentences: There exists an unbreakable bond between Seattle and Starbucks, such that the mere mention of this city brings to mind the aroma of full-bodied coffee.
Accompanied by undulating coastline and harbor scenery, this aroma, associated with the color blue, also possesses a hint of fresh seafood.
It is a blend that is as unique as Seattle!

articles.title: 閱讀與獨旅｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
articles.source: 2024 夏｜The Solitary Sojourns, The Literary Escapades
sentences: Embarking on a solo journey has become an art of spontaneous expression!
Immersing oneself in the world of reading, one dives into the vast ocean of words, embarking on an enriching journey guided by the author’s words.

articles.title: 遠方目的地與台北轉機｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
sentences: This year, instead of just dreaming, make your New Year’s resolution a reality.
Why not break free from the ordinary and explore the extraordinary in 2025.
Even if the dream destination is far away, it’s still worth the journey.
Your bucket list doesn’t need to be long, just visiting one destination this year can make all the difference.
Whether you prefer a direct route or a scenic detour, why not add a stopover in Taipei?
This charming layover offers a refreshing break, whether you’re escaping Southeast Asia’s heat for Europe’s chill or swapping winter for the Southern Hemisphere’s summer.
Make your trip more memorable with a quick, exciting detour!
Let’s be real—these flight deals are unbeatable, but why rush to your destination when you can enjoy the freedom of a stopover?

This issue of Dynasty spotlights four routes: Brisbane–Taipei–London to explore a city’s green heart as the perfect gateway to a magical outdoor adventure, Bali–Taipei–Frankfurt where a captivating journey from performances blending tradition and mythology to the essence of classical beauty, Ho Chi Minh City–Taipei–Los Angeles to explore immigrant cuisine, and Manila–Taipei–Vancouver to experience indigenous art.
Which route will ignite your New Year’s wanderlust?
Your ideal destination awaits.

articles.title: 溫泉與療癒｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
sentences: Whether it’s a steamy bowl of soup on a winter’s night or the rising mist of volcanic springs, hot water has always held a special place in the human quest for comfort.
Across cultures and climates, hot springs remain a timeless remedy for both body and soul.

articles.title: 白川鄉點燈活動｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
sentences: A UNESCO World Heritage village in Gifu Prefecture, Shirakawa-go hosts its winter light-up each year, illuminating its steep thatched gassho-zukuri roofs against the snow.
The 2026 events take place on January 12, 18, 25, and February 1, best viewed from the Shiroyama Observatory, where the entire glowing village spreads beneath the stars.
There are 14 weekly flights on Taipei-Nagoya route.

articles.title: 義大利維亞雷焦嘉年華｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
sentences: Dating back to 1873, this is one of Italy’s largest carnivals, famous for its massive paper-mâché floats and lively street parades.
Originally a lighthearted Shrove Tuesday procession, it has evolved into a national spectacle drawing over half a million visitors.
In 2026, six parades will ignite the streets on February 1, 7, 12, 15, 17, and 21.
There are direct flights from Taipei to Europe, with six major destinations including Rome, Amsterdam, Prague, Vienna, Frankfurt, and London.

articles.title: Grand Tour 與跨文化旅行｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
articles.source: 2026 夏｜Recalibrate Your World Through a Grand Tour
sentences: Blur the lines between urban pulse and natural wonder.
From timeless classics to cutting-edge culture, let history ignite your senses.
Embark on a grand tour that defies boundaries and expands your world.
In 18th-century Europe, the Grand Tour was the definitive rite of passage for young British aristocrats.
Leaving their comfort zones for the art of Rome and the majesty of the Alps, they learned to observe, reflect, and broaden their horizons.
This journey didn’t just shape their personal worldviews; it propelled British landscape painting into a new era of human and natural connection.
Today, we may not travel solely for art or view the journey as a trial, yet the modern Grand Tour remains.
It is hidden in every departure from the familiar.
As urban scales, cultural dialects, technological shifts, and the breath of nature intersect, we recalibrate our understanding of the world and ourselves within these multi-dimensional spaces.
Plan your crossing now.
In Seattle, hear how innovative thinking thrives alongside forests and coasts.
In Vienna, let the orderly beauty of classical music converse with the daily rhythms of a modern city.
Step into diverse Vancouver to see a tapestry of inclusive cultures, or in Sapporo, surrender your senses to culinary experiments that blend terroir, the seasons, and the spirit of the artisan.
Travel is your unique signature for seeing the world.
Those seemingly distant borders become the starting point for understanding the globe the moment you begin to plan.
Your Grand Tour begins with a single step.

articles.title: 世界是藝術發現的舞台｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
sentences: Whether it’s autumn in the North or spring in the South, the world is a stage for artistic discovery.
Uncover ancient Egypt at the Hong Kong Palace Museum’s exhibit or witness the fusion of tradition and modernity at the Edinburgh International Festival.
From the rugged artistry of the Calgary Stampede to the floral elegance of Canberra’s Floriade, every corner of the globe offers a unique masterpiece to explore.

articles.title: State Library Victoria｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
articles.source: 使用者提供的《Dynasty》原文示例
sentences: Bathed in midday sunlight, this peaceful sanctuary, home to over two million books, is known as "a cathedral of books."

The State Library Victoria, established in 1856, attracts morning crowds rivaling those at England's British Library and the Library of Congress in Washington D.C., making it as one of the world's busiest libraries.
Inside, the library houses various reading rooms, exhibitions, and galleries.
The La Trobe Reading Room, opened in 1913, rises 6 stories high and was the world's largest reinforced concrete building at the time.
Renowned for its iconic dome ceiling, radial wooden tables, and classic furnishings, it exudes a sense of enduring elegance.

articles.title: 倫敦馬拉松與歐洲航點｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
sentences: The London Marathon has been a World Marathon Major staple since 1981, tracing a scenic route along the River Thames every April.
While it once led the world in speed records—a title now often held by U.S. races—London has reinvented itself as a hub of theatrical flair.
Today, over 30,000 participants take part, featuring legendary costumed runners like those in 50-kilogram diving suits who turn the pursuit of the slowest finish into a celebrated spectacle.
There are direct flights from Taipei to Europe, with six major destinations including London, Amsterdam, Prague, Vienna, Rome, and Frankfurt.

articles.title: 菲律賓 Sumakah 豐收節｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
sentences: Every May 1st, Antipolo City erupts into a vibrant month-long celebration honoring Our Lady of Peace and Good Voyage.
This sensory feast centers on the Sumakah staples: Suman, a sticky rice cake; Mangga, or mango; Kasoy, or cashew; and Hamaka, meaning hammock.
Expect kaleidoscopic street parades, high-energy dance competitions set to the local anthem Tayo Na Sa Antipolo, and bustling craft markets that showcase the best of Filipino heritage.
There are 18 weekly flights on the Taipei-Manila route, and four weekly flights on the Kaohsiung-Manila route.

articles.title: 東京山王祭｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
sentences: As one of the Big Three festivals of old Tokyo, the Sanno Festival at Hie Shrine signals the official arrival of summer.
This 11-day mid-June celebration peaks with the Shinkosai, a spectacular nine-hour procession.

Featuring imperial carriages and portable shrines, or mikoshi, the 300-meter parade weaves through the skyscrapers of modern Tokyo, momentarily transforming the urban sprawl into a living scene from the Edo period.
There are daily flights from Taipei and Kaohsiung to Narita, and daily flights from Songshan to Haneda.

articles.title: 德國基爾帆船週｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
sentences: Held every June in Kiel, the capital of Schleswig-Holstein, Kiel Week reigns as one of the world’s premier sailing events.

This massive maritime festival unites 5,000 sailors and 2,000 vessels with nearly three million spectators, serving as a vital leg of the Sailing World Cup alongside elite regattas in Spain, France, and the Netherlands.
The week-long adventure concludes with a bang, as a grand fireworks display illuminates the harbor on the final night.
There are direct flights from Taipei to six major destinations in Europe.

articles.title: 札幌的季節轉換｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
articles.source: Dynasty-2026-Summer.pdf｜雜誌第 14 頁｜Sapporo’s Seasonal Shift
sentences: As the pristine white of winter recedes, Sapporo awakens to the crisp air of early spring, often greeted by the arrival of cherry blossoms in full bloom.
Trading its snowy coat for a city draped in spring hues, Sapporo invites travelers to step into a brand-new season.

articles.title: 香港故宮古埃及文明展｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
articles.source: Dynasty-2026-Autumn.pdf｜雜誌第 03 頁｜Ancient Egypt Unveiled
sentences: The Hong Kong Palace Museum brings 5,000 years of history to life in a spectacular new exhibition.
Ancient Egypt Unveiled features 250 rare artifacts from seven Egyptian museums, including a legendary colossal statue of Tutankhamun.
Spanning from 4,000 BCE, the collection showcases pharaoh statues, animal mummies, and ornate sarcophagi.
From royal jewelry to everyday tools, these exclusive treasures offer a breathtaking window into one of the world’s greatest civilizations.
There are 42 weekly flights on the Taipei-Hong Kong route, and 14 weekly flights on the Kaohsiung-Hong Kong route.

articles.title: 加拿大卡加利牛仔節｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
sentences: Each July, Calgary, Alberta, explodes into life for the Calgary Stampede, a 10-day spectacle drawing over a million visitors.
Tracing its roots to an 1886 agricultural fair and a 1919 victory celebration, the event officially merged into a local legend in 1923.
Today, the event is an all-encompassing spectacle, featuring grand parades, midways, and stage shows alongside live concerts, agricultural competitions, chuckwagon races, and Indigenous exhibitions.
There are seven weekly flights on the Taipei-Vancouver route.

articles.title: 愛丁堡國際藝術節｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
articles.source: Dynasty-2026-Autumn.pdf｜雜誌第 05 頁｜Edinburgh International Festival
sentences: Every August, Edinburgh transforms into a global arts capital.
The International Festival celebrates classical elegance with an invite-only program of symphony, opera, ballet, and theater.
Meanwhile, the Festival Fringe offers a spirited contrast, filling every available space with experimental theater, comedy, and street performances.
Together, they create a dynamic dialogue between refined tradition and spontaneous energy, showcasing the incredible vitality of artistic expression.
There are direct flights from Taipei to Europe, with six major destinations.

articles.title: 澳洲坎培拉花展｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
sentences: As the Northern Hemisphere celebrates autumn, Australia welcomes spring with Floriade.
Held annually from mid-September to mid-October in Commonwealth Park, this month-long festival was inspired by the Netherlands’ Keukenhof Gardens.
Its name, Latin for ‘to design with flowers,’ is reflected in over a million blooming tulips, daffodils, and hyacinths.
Combined with live music, markets, and workshops, it is a vibrant tribute to nature’s renewal.
There are five weekly flights on the Taipei-Sydney route.

articles.title: 紐約街頭藝術｜英文原文朗讀／英翻中
articles.source: Dynasty-2026-Autumn.pdf｜雜誌第 08 頁｜Raw Creative Pulse
sentences: In New York, art claims the city without permission.
From subway walls to abandoned warehouses, it pulses through the streets in spray paint and neon—not just inhabiting the pavement, but commanding attention.
There are four weekly flights on the Taipei-New York route, and starting August 5, service expands to five weekly flights.
Please check the official website for detailed flight schedules.

articles.title: Somebody Feed Phil：華航貴賓室登上 Netflix
sentences: Traveling the world isn’t enough, the real adventure is tasting global cuisines!
China Airlines teams up with the NETFLIX’s American show Somebody Feed Phil for a groundbreaking collaboration in its seventh season.
Host Philip Rosenthal makes a special visit to Taiwan, appearing in China Airlines’ VIP lounge at Taoyuan Airport.
There, amidst the lounge’s unique Eastern aesthetic, he savors the classic local flavor of “China Airlines Beef Noodle Soup.”
Philip flies China Airlines for his first-ever visit to Taiwan, to share the world-renowned “China Airlines Beef Noodle Soup.”
The tender, chewy beef melts in his mouth at first bite, paired with a richly aromatic special braised broth, earning Philip’s endless praise.
He is also impressed by China Airlines’ comfortable cabin amenities and excellent in-flight service.
China Airlines serves six major North American destinations: Los Angeles, San Francisco, Ontario, Seattle, New York, and Vancouver.
Complemented by nearly 400 weekly flights across Northeast and Southeast Asia.

articles.title: A350-1000 與 777X 客貨機訂單
sentences: China Airlines (CAL) had signed a formal order with Airbus for ten A350-1000 widebody aircraft with deliveries in 2029.
Additionally, CAL will begin upgrading the cabins aboard its existing fleet of A350-900 aircraft in 2027.
The upgraded aircraft will join the new A350-1000 aircraft to form CAL’s new flagship fleet of A350s with their distinctive Asian aesthetics.
CAL also formally placed an order with Boeing for ten 777-9 widebody aircraft and four 777-8F freighters, with an option to acquire nine more.
Delivery is expected to commence in 2030.
CAL will be the first Taiwanese airline to introduce the 777X model.
The combination of passenger and cargo aircraft will enhance the competitiveness of the airline’s global network and offer exceptional aviation services.
Sustainable corporate development is a top priority for CAL.
As the 777-9 aircraft and 777-8F freighters offer outstanding fuel efficiency and environmental friendliness with fuel consumption and carbon emissions reduced by up to 25%.
The move will also help the carrier realize its goal of net zero emissions by 2050.
CAL will continue to provide air travel services that are more efficient, environmentally friendly, and innovative.

articles.title: 華航與 Southwest Airlines 聯票合作
sentences: China Airlines (CAL) has announced to launch Interline Tickets with Southwest Airlines.
Tickets are now officially on sale and offering travelers with seamless connecting flights starting January 2026.

CAL President Kevin Chen (3rd from left) and Southwest Airlines Vice Chairman of the Board, President & CEO Bob Jordan (3rd from right) signed a memorandum of understanding at Southwest Airlines headquarters in Dallas.
CAL offers travelers non-stop flights to five West Coast gateway cities in the US.
From there, travelers can catch connecting Southwest Airlines flights to other cities throughout US.
Interline tickets (one itinerary) can now be booked through the CAL web starting January 19, 2026 along with domestic legs on Southwest Airlines.

Now, CAL operates more than 40 flights a week to and from New York, Los Angeles, Ontario, San Francisco, Seattle, and Phoenix in the United States, as well as Vancouver in Canada, while integration with extensive regional networks will provide nearly 500 flights each week for transit travelers traveling between Asia and North America.

articles.title: Zootopia 2 主題彩繪機
sentences: China Airlines (CAL) introduced Taiwan’s first Disney-themed aircraft, decorating with “Zootopia 2,” by Walt Disney Animation Studios.
The Zootopia 2 themed livery plane featured on CAL’s long-range 777.
The fuselage is decorated with heroes Judy Hopps and Nick Wilde, as well as Gary De’Snake and Nibbles Maplestick.
The Zootopia 2 themed livery plane will initially be based out of Taipei (Taoyuan) and assigned to the Los Angeles, Ontario, Bangkok, Tokyo, and Osaka routes.
A dedicated web page for the Zootopia 2 themed livery plane has been launched on the CAL website.
The page offers a wealth of content including the liveried aircraft, latest events, behind-the-scenes videos, cabin amenities, and special offers on key routes.
Passengers can use this page as a one-stop hub on the plane updates, as well as booking inquiries and reservations.
CAL Zootopia 2 themed livery plane website: https://zootopia2livery.china-airlines.com/en/

articles.title: Google Find Hub 行李追蹤功能
sentences: China Airlines (CAL) has officially announced its support for Google’s Find Hub, becoming the first airline in Taiwan to offer travelers comprehensive luggage tracking options.
Leading the industry, CAL supports both Apple AirTag and Google’s Find Hub, extending tracking to Android™ users.

By using compatible smart tags, travelers can leverage Google’s global network to monitor checked bags and generate secure links to share location with the airline, accelerating efficient luggage recovery.
As one of Find Hub’s inaugural global partners, CAL integrates the “share item location” feature with existing systems for tracking.
To ensure privacy, shared links automatically deactivate upon luggage recovery or expire after seven days.

CAL is committed to digital innovation, offering traveler-focused services like the CAL AI Customer Service Agent, China Airlines App, Dynasty Sky Reading, iFoundU and other functions to create a smarter, more convenient journey.

articles.title: 豪華經濟艙全面升級
sentences: China Airlines is upgrading its Premium Economy, optimizing everything from check-in and amenities to dining and service.
This offers discerning travelers a more thoughtful, high-value choice in the skies.
The new tableware design fuses modern and Eastern aesthetics, featuring elegant white porcelain with a delicate texture.
China Airlines also introduced noise-reducing headphones, single-packed hand wipes, and plush quilts.
Passengers receive a free luggage allowance of two 28-kilogram pieces.
Those on Boeing 777 and Airbus A350 aircraft enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, along with priority check-in and expedited boarding.

articles.title: 台北直飛鳳凰城新航線
sentences: The new Taipei-Phoenix service is operated by China Airlines’ next-generation A350-900 passenger aircraft.
Phoenix is a vital gateway to the American Southwest and a key transit point for many connecting itineraries.
It is China Airlines’ seventh destination in North America and its first in the American Southwest.
The non-stop flights operate every Wednesday, Friday, and Sunday.
With a flight time of approximately 12 hours, the route saves travelers six hours over connecting flights.
From Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport, passengers can connect to cities such as Denver, Dallas, Houston, Las Vegas, and Chicago.

articles.title: 華航公益桌球營移師彰化
sentences: China Airlines has brought its charity table tennis camp to Changhua for the first time.
The event invited Chuang Chih-Yuan, the godfather of Taiwanese table tennis, to provide professional guidance and inspire children with positive energy and the courage to pursue their dreams.
Students practiced warm-ups, grip techniques, footwork, reaction drills, and friendly matches.
This hands-on training aimed to foster confidence, proactive action, and a resilient spirit when facing challenges.
The airline plans to expand these charity initiatives to more regions and offer professional training in table tennis, baseball, badminton, and basketball.

articles.title: Pikachu Jet CI2 A350 彩繪機
sentences: China Airlines has officially launched the Pikachu Jet CI2, Taiwan’s first Airbus A350 passenger aircraft decorated with a Pokémon-themed livery.
Featuring 13 Pokémon and an exquisite floral tile pattern of auspicious clouds, the fuselage exemplifies the aesthetics of Taiwanese craftsmanship.
The theme extends from airport check-in and in-flight amenities to children’s meals.
Since joining the Pokémon Air Adventures program in 2022, China Airlines has continued the collaboration with The Pokémon Company.
The themed aircraft connects destinations such as Tokyo and Seattle while bringing the joy of travel to global travelers.

articles.title: S&P 全球永續年鑑 Top 1%
sentences: China Airlines has secured the top spot in the global airline industry in the 2026 S&P Global Sustainability Yearbook.
It is the only airline ranked in the global Top 1%, and the only Taiwanese transportation company to be included in the Yearbook for nine years.
The Yearbook, based on the Corporate Sustainability Assessment, evaluated over 9,200 companies across 59 industries, with only eight airlines making the 2026 shortlist.
China Airlines achieved the highest score in the airline industry, received full marks in 23 indicators, and led the industry in eight key categories.

articles.title: 全新華夏哩程酬賓計畫三大亮點
articles.source: Dynasty-2026-Autumn.pdf｜雜誌第 39 頁｜Dynasty Flyer Program
sentences: The new Dynasty Flyer Program introduces three key highlights.
First, intuitive earning and instant upgrades: the new Status Points streamline upgrade and renewal thresholds, so members are upgraded as soon as they qualify.
Second, Miles, Your Way: miles transfer and purchase are available, with more partnerships for accommodation and vouchers coming soon.
Third, Go Sustainable, Get Rewards: members can complete a sustainability challenge to receive flight discounts.
There are four membership tiers: Dynasty, Gold, Emerald, and Paragon.

articles.title: Welcome Speech 歡迎詞
sentences: Good morning (afternoon, evening)!
Ladies and gentlemen, welcome aboard (Comma航空公司) flight (0018) from (臺北) to (舊金山).
Our flight will take 12 hours and 15 minutes.

To be safe, passengers are not allowed to use mobile phone, remote controlled toys and other electronic devices throughout the flight, and the laptop computers are not allowed to use during take-off and landing.
We will take off immediately.
Now the cabin attendants are going to have a security check.

Please be seated, fasten your seat belt and make sure your seat back is straight up, your tray table is closed and your carry-on items are securely stowed in the overhead bin or under the seat in front of you.
This is a non-smoking flight, please do not smoke on board.
We hope you enjoy the flight!
Thank you!

articles.title: After Take-off 起飛後
sentences: Ladies and gentlemen, the Captain has turned off the Fasten Seat Belt sign, and you may now move around the cabin.
However we always recommend to keep your seat belt fastened while you’re seated.
In a few moments, we will be serving you meal with tea, coffee and other soft drinks.
Welcome to make your choice.
Please put down the table in front of you.
For the convenience of the passenger behind you, please return your seat back to the upright position during the meal service.
Thank you!

articles.title: Turbulence 顛簸
sentences: Ladies and gentlemen, we are now encountering some turbulence.
Please return to your seats and fasten your seat belt.
Lavatory is not to be used.
When you are using lavatory, please hold the handle tightly.
During turbulence, we will stop the cabin service.
Thank you!

articles.title: Before Landing 降落前
sentences: Ladies and Gentlemen, This is Captain speaking.
We expect to land at Osaka in 15 minutes.
The estimated time of arrival will be at 14:15.
The local time now is 13:55 and the ground temperature is 20 degree centigrade.
Please fasten your seat belt.
We would like to thank you for flying with us.
We do hope you have enjoyed your flight, thank you.

articles.title: After Landing 降落後
sentences: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to HNL Airport.
For your safety and comfort, please remain seated and keep your mobile phones power off until the airplane has come to a complete stop.
Please be sure to take all your belongings when you disembark.
Your checked baggage may be claimed in the terminal building.
Thank you for joining us on this trip and we are looking forward to seeing you on board again in the near future.
Have a nice stay!

articles.title: STARLUX Self-intro (Video, EN)
sentences: Hello.
My name is Shelly.
With confidence in my English and Korean skills, I enjoy connecting with international guests.
Currently, I work at the front desk of Hyatt hotel.
My colleagues see me as a very reliable teammate because I can handle tasks independently and remain calm under pressure.
I look forward to bringing this professional stability to STARLUX Airlines.
Thank you!

articles.title: STARLUX Self-intro (Interview, EN)
sentences: Hello, my name is Shelly.
I am confident in communicating in both English and Korean.
Currently, I work at the front desk of a Hyatt hotel, where I serve international guests in a fast-paced environment.
I am detail-oriented and proactive in anticipating guest needs, and I remain calm and reliable even in busy or unexpected situations.
I look forward to bringing this experience into the cabin and providing attentive and reassuring service to every passenger.
Thank you.

sentences: Hi, my name is Shelly.
